安卓和电脑可使用浏览器的“安装应用”或“添加到主屏幕”。未出现安装按钮时，可按浏: On Android and computers, use “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen” in your browser. If no install button appears, use the browser menu.
默认将账目保存在当前网址、当前浏览器或桌面应用的本地存储中。主动开启云同步后，账: By default, records are stored locally for this address in the current browser or installed app. With cloud sync enabled, records are encrypted on your device before upload. Local web storage is unencrypted; encrypted backup exports are password-protected.
清除网站数据、卸载、存储空间不足或换设备都可能导致数据丢失。请在设置中定期导出加: Clearing site data, uninstalling, low storage or changing devices can cause data loss. Export encrypted backups in Settings, save them outside the device and check that they can be restored.
请固定使用同一个网址。换域名、浏览器或改从桌面图标打开时，不要假设数据自动共享；: Use the same address consistently. Do not assume records are shared when changing domains, browsers or opening from a home-screen icon. Back up and check that all records are present first.
首次下载、获取新版和云同步需要联网；离线就绪后可离线记账、统计、导出和恢复本地文: The first download, updates and cloud sync require internet access. Once ready, recording, statistics, exports and local restores work offline. The hosting provider serves app files and optional sync, and may keep access logs such as IP addresses and browser details. The app has no advertising or analytics scripts.
有新版时主动确认更新。请先保存编辑并关闭其他记账页面。更新只更换程序缓存，不清除: Confirm updates when available. Save edits and close other ledger pages first. Updating replaces the app cache without clearing records.
程序已缓存在本机，可断网使用。账目请另存加密备份。: App files are cached for offline use. Keep encrypted backups of your records separately.
首次使用请保持联网，等待离线文件准备完成。: On first use, stay online until offline files are ready.
检查完成；如有新版，下载完成后会显示更新按钮。: Check complete. If an update is available, an update button appears when the download finishes.
当前浏览器不支持申请持久存储，请定期导出备份。: This browser cannot request persistent storage. Export backups regularly.
已获准持久存储；主动清除、卸载或设备损坏仍会丢失数据。: Persistent storage granted. Clearing data, uninstalling or device damage can still cause data loss.
浏览器暂未授予持久存储，可从主屏幕打开后再试；请定期备份。: Persistent storage was not granted. Try opening from the home screen, and keep backing up regularly.
新版已下载。先保存编辑并关闭其他记账窗口，再更新；也可稍后关闭所有窗口后重新打开: Update downloaded. Save edits and close other ledger windows before updating, or close all windows and reopen later.
网页版使用本地浏览器存储，清除网站数据会清除账目。更换网址前请先导出备份。: The web app uses local browser storage. Clearing site data removes records. Export a backup before changing addresses.
同步配置损坏，请保留本地数据并导出备份: Sync configuration is damaged. Preserve local data and export a backup.
请关闭其他旧版页面后重试: Close other pages running an older version and retry.
本地数据或同步账号已变化，请重试同步: Local data or the sync account changed. Try syncing again.
同步保存失败，本地数据保持原样: Unable to save sync data. Local data is unchanged.
数据已在另一页面更新，请刷新后重试: Data was updated on another page. Refresh and retry.
本地保存失败，请检查存储空间: Local save failed. Check available storage.
本机保护副本保存失败，请检查存储空间: Unable to save the protection copy. Check available storage.
数据发生变化，请重新打开页面后重试: Data changed. Reopen the page and retry.
此存储不支持云同步: This storage does not support cloud sync.
当前存储不支持本机保护: This storage does not support local protection.
此平台暂未接入云同步，可继续使用本地加密存储和文件备份。: Cloud sync is not available on this platform yet. Local encrypted storage and file backups still work.
与网页版共用账号和账本：: Shares accounts and ledgers with the web app:
换手机或在另一台设备使用，请先连接已有空间。无需先创建空账本。: On a new or second device, connect to your existing space first. You do not need to create an empty ledger.
本地测试环境：这里的同步不会上传到正式网站。多设备使用请打开同一个正式网址。: Local test environment: this sync does not upload to the production website. Use the same production address on all devices.
个账本有记录。请查看全部账本并切换；同名账本也会分别保留。: other ledgers have records. View all ledgers to switch. Ledgers with the same name remain separate.
开启后同步所有账本、记录、分类、支付方式、预算和模板。草稿和文件备份记录仅保留在: Syncs all ledgers, records, categories, payment methods, budgets and templates. Drafts and file-backup history stay on this device. You can keep recording offline.
同步配置暂时无法读取，请重试: Unable to read sync configuration. Please retry.
本机和云端数据都保留。重新连接时可使用已绑定的账号密码或原同步密钥。请先保存恢复: Local and cloud data will be preserved. Reconnect using your linked account or original sync key. Save your recovery key first; unsynced changes will stay on this device.
如何在另一台设备继续记账？: How do I continue on another device?
两台设备打开同一个网站。已绑定账号时选择“账号登录”；老用户也可使用已有密钥连接: Open the same website on both devices. Use “Account sign-in” if linked, or connect with an existing key. Check that both show the same sync space ID, then view all ledgers.
首次使用先创建同步空间，再到“账号与密码”绑定账号。创建码只用于新建空间，不是登: First create a sync space, then link an account under “Account & password”. The creation code only creates spaces; it is not a login password. The original sync key is also your recovery key for decryption and password resets. Store it in a password manager and do not share it.
两端原始数据暂时保留。选择每项要保留的版本后再同步；关联数据冲突会按整个账本选择: Original data on both devices is temporarily preserved. Choose the version to keep for each item before syncing. Linked-data conflicts are resolved for the whole ledger. A local protection copy is saved before syncing.
同步密钥就是登录凭证，也用于解密账目。请保存到密码管理器，不要发给别人。密钥遗失: Your sync key grants access and decrypts your records. Save it in a password manager and do not share it. If the key is lost and all devices are disconnected, cloud records cannot be recovered.
密钥已复制，请保存到安全位置: Key copied. Save it somewhere safe.
无法自动复制，请手动选择并复制密钥: Unable to copy automatically. Select and copy the key manually.
创建码由网站管理员配置，只在创建时使用。连接已有空间不需要创建码。: The administrator sets the creation code. It is only needed when creating a space, not when connecting to an existing one.
我已安全保存同步密钥: I have saved my sync key securely
连接后，会将本机所有账本与此空间合并并开启自动同步。已有记录不会整库覆盖；冲突会: Connecting merges all local ledgers with this space and enables automatic sync. Existing records are not replaced wholesale. You will be asked to resolve conflicts.
模板已不存在，请重新打开: This template no longer exists. Reopen it.
每个账本最多保存 20 个模板: Each ledger can have up to 20 templates.
已有同名模板: A template with this name already exists.
尚未保存的模板修改会丢失。: Unsaved changes to this template will be lost.
· 模板按账本和币种保存。使用时预填，确认后才记入账本。: · Templates are saved by ledger and currency. They prefill entries, which are saved only after confirmation.
留空则每次输入；支持加减算式。更换币种不会换算金额。: Leave blank to enter each time. Addition and subtraction are supported. Changing currency does not convert the amount.
还没有模板。可以保存早餐、通勤、房租等常用记录。: No templates yet. Save frequent entries such as breakfast, commuting or rent.
删除“{0}”不会影响已有记录。: Deleting “{0}” will not affect existing entries.
这是点击生成时的快照。请确认文件已保存，再关闭此窗口。iPhone 可在系统分享: This is a snapshot from when you generated the file. Confirm it has been saved before closing. On iPhone, choose “Save to Files” in the share sheet.
已交给系统分享，请确认文件已保存。: Sent to the system share sheet. Confirm the file has been saved.
已取消分享，可再次分享或下载文件。: Sharing cancelled. You can share again or download the file.
系统分享未完成，请使用下载文件。: System sharing did not finish. Use Download file.
账号请使用 3–32 位英文字母、数字、下划线或短横线，以字母或数字开头: Use 3–32 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens for the username, starting with a letter or number.
密码需要 8–128 个字符；请勿重复使用其他网站的密码: Passwords must be 8–128 characters. Do not reuse a password from another website.
账号加密参数无效，请更新应用后重试: Invalid account encryption parameters. Update the app and retry.
网站尚未部署账号服务，请联系管理员升级: Account services are not deployed on this website. Ask the administrator to upgrade.
账号操作失败，请稍后重试: Account operation failed. Please retry later.
连接中断或超时。若正在设置密码，请重新打开账号设置确认结果；原同步密钥仍可使用: Connection interrupted or timed out. If you were setting a password, reopen account settings to check the result. Your original sync key still works.
账号信息无效，请更新应用: Invalid account information. Update the app.
账号密钥无法解锁，请使用恢复密钥连接后重新设置密码；本地账目保留: Unable to unlock the account key. Connect with your recovery key and reset the password. Local records are preserved.
此空间尚未绑定账号，请先使用同步密钥连接，再设置账号密码: This space has no linked account. Connect with the sync key, then set a username and password.
已断开，账目保留在本机: Disconnected. Records remain on this device.
当前服务尚未部署云同步接口，本地记账可继续使用: Cloud sync is not deployed on this service. Local bookkeeping still works.
云服务返回了不支持的数据: The cloud service returned unsupported data.
云端快照缺失或格式错误，本地数据保留，请联系管理员检查数据库: The cloud snapshot is missing or invalid. Local data is preserved. Ask the administrator to check the database.
请等待当前同步完成: Wait for the current sync to finish.
本机账目已关联其他同步空间。请先导出备份并清空本机，再连接其他密钥，避免混入不同: Local records are linked to another sync space. Export a backup and clear local data before connecting with another key to avoid mixing accounts.
离线中，修改已保存在本机，联网后同步: Offline. Changes are saved locally and will sync when connected.
连接中断或超时，修改仍保存在本机，稍后重试: Connection interrupted or timed out. Changes remain on this device. Retry later.
云端版本发生回退，本地数据保留，请先导出备份并联系管理员检查数据库: The cloud version has moved backwards. Local data is preserved. Export a backup and ask the administrator to check the database.
本机有新修改，将在下一次同步时合并: New local changes will be merged on the next sync.
同步配置读取失败，本地记账不受影响: Unable to read sync configuration. Local bookkeeping is unaffected.
修改已保存在本机，等待同步: Changes saved locally, waiting to sync
同步密钥格式不正确，请完整粘贴以 pl1_ 开头的密钥: Invalid sync key. Paste the complete key starting with pl1_.
云同步数据超过当前 1.3 MB 上限，本地记账不受影响，请先导出备份: Cloud sync data exceeds the current 1.3 MB limit. Local bookkeeping is unaffected. Export a backup first.
云同步数据过大，请先导出备份: Cloud sync data is too large. Export a backup first.
云端数据无法解密或版本不支持；本地数据保留，请检查同步密钥或更新应用: Unable to decrypt cloud data or unsupported version. Local data is preserved. Check your sync key or update the app.
有修改冲突，请选择要保留的版本: Conflicting changes found. Choose which versions to keep.
合并后超过账本或记录限制，请先导出备份并整理数据，再重试同步: The merge exceeds ledger or entry limits. Export a backup and organize your data before syncing again.
同步服务地址无效，请更新应用: Invalid sync service address. Update the app.
同步服务发生重定向，请更新应用: The sync service redirected the request. Update the app.
连接中断或超时，请稍后重试: Connection interrupted or timed out. Please retry later.
账号服务尚未配置，请先升级并绑定登录限流服务；原密钥同步不受影响: Account services are not configured. Upgrade and connect the sign-in rate limiter first. Existing key-based sync is unaffected.
账号操作过于频繁，请稍后重试: Too many account requests. Please retry later.
账号请求格式或大小不正确: Invalid account request format or size
请先连接同步空间，或使用恢复密钥: Connect to a sync space first, or use your recovery key.
同步空间不存在，请检查恢复密钥: Sync space not found. Check your recovery key.
只接受受支持的加密密钥: Only supported encrypted keys are accepted.
此空间已绑定账号，请重新打开账号设置: This space already has a linked account. Reopen account settings.
账号已被使用或空间已绑定，请重新打开账号设置: Username already taken or space already linked. Reopen account settings.
账号状态已变化，请重新打开账号设置: Account status changed. Reopen account settings.
另一台设备刚修改了密码，请重新打开账号设置: Another device just changed the password. Reopen account settings.
账号服务暂不可用，请确认数据库已升级后重试；原同步密钥仍可使用: Account service unavailable. Check that the database has been upgraded and retry. Your original sync key still works.
云同步尚未配置，请先完成 D1 数据库绑定: Cloud sync is not configured. Bind the D1 database first.
同步过于频繁，请稍后重试: Too many sync requests. Please retry later.
创建请求过于频繁，请稍后重试: Too many creation requests. Please retry later.
创建码不正确，或管理员尚未开启创建同步空间: Incorrect creation code, or the administrator has not enabled new sync spaces.
同步空间不存在，请检查密钥；本地数据不会清除: Sync space not found. Check your key. Local data will not be cleared.
同步数据超过大小上限: Sync data exceeds the size limit.
同步数据格式或大小不正确: Invalid sync data format or size
只接受受支持的加密数据: Only supported encrypted data is accepted.
另一台设备已同步，请重新合并后重试: Another device has synced. Merge again and retry.
云服务暂不可用，请稍后重试；本地记账不受影响: Cloud service unavailable. Retry later. Local bookkeeping is unaffected.
该月未设置 {0} 预算: No {0} budget set for this month.
请先关闭其他记账标签页或桌面窗口，再更新。: Close other ledger tabs or app windows before updating.
